name: Middlehaven dockside
description: Open former dock land by the Tees in Middlesbrough. Room for a big building, on made and wet ground.
attribution: Terrain: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data / Mapzen), including data from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, EU-DEM (Copernicus) and national LIDAR sources

licence.note: Derived from OpenStreetMap data, available under the Open Database Licence. Show '© OpenStreetMap contributors' wherever this site is used.

axes: metres; x east, y up, z south (-z is north); y = 0 is the plot's mean ground level

terrain.encoding: float32le, row-major, rows run +z (north to south), columns run +x (west to east)

factors.label: Neighbours close to the boundary
factors.detail: 1 building(s) within 6 m of the boundary, the nearest right on it (party wall or shared boundary). Needs careful excavation, scaffolding and demolition.

factors.label: Sloping site
factors.detail: Falls about 5% to the south-east, 4.6 m across the plot. Expect cut and fill, retaining walls or stepped foundations.

factors.label: Awkward plot shape
factors.detail: Irregular outline (fills 73% of its bounding rectangle).

factors.label: Trees to protect
factors.detail: 3 tree(s) on the plot and 0 on the boundary. Root zones limit where foundations can go.
